D12Digital

Logic Processor

Four logic channels, fast enough for audio

Four inputs with adjustable thresholds, four outputs with selectable logic functions. Fast enough for audio: XOR of two oscillators sounds much like a ring modulator.

  • AND, OR, XOR and more
  • Display shows the logic routing
  • For gates, clocks and audio-rate squares
